Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 18-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Soft Computing Techniques [ELE_4410]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Describe any two activation functions used in training artificial neural networks with necessary      (5)  
  mathematical expression and its graphical representation?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Illustrate the winner take-all learning method used in learning of neural networks with computational (5)  
  steps.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Analyse the error backpropagation algorithm used in training the multilayer feed-forward neural       (5)  
  network with necessary computational steps.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Explain the RBF kernel for modelling multivariate data with expression. Explain the interpretation of (5)  
  covariance matrix used in it.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                Build the fuzzy Sugino inference model for decision making with computational steps.                  (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Describe and construct convex and non-convex fuzzy sets used in fuzzy inference with an example (5)  
  each along with its membership function.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Analyse crossover and mutation operators used in genetic algorithms as operators. Explain the         (5)  
  analogy of these operators in natural evolution process of human.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Explain how a minimization problem in optimization can be carried out using genetic algorithm by      (5)  
  maximizing the fitness function. Explain in detail.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                With a neat architecture, explain the adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS)?                  (5)  
  
  Page #1

A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Differentiate between fuzzy neural network and ANFIS, used as decision support systems?             (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
